item.title: Digital Edge invests $4.5B to build Indonesia’s largest AI-ready hyperscale campus
item.description: Singapore-based data center firm Digital Edge announced Wednesday a $4.5 billion investment to build CGK Campus, one of Indonesia’s largest artificial intelligence (AI)-ready hyperscale data center campuses, in the GIIC Industrial Estate in Bekasi.

item.title: ST Telemedia Global Data Center inks partnerships with four institutes for AI training
item.description: ST Telemedia Global Data Centers (STT GDC), the Singapore-based data center colocation provider, has signed memorandum of understandings (MOUs) with the Institute of Technical Education (ITE), Singapore Polytechnic (SP), NTU Singapore and National University of Singapore (NUS), to advance skills development and expand internship and early career pathways for Singaporeans entering the workforce.

item.title: Apex Securities foresees slower EV demand growth in Malaysia this year
item.description: Apex Securities has foreseen slower electric vehicle (EV) demand growth in Malaysia this year amid policy changes.

item.title: 2026 Retail reset: Why value-first platforms will define Malaysia’s year ahead
item.description: As Malaysia prepares for 2026, one theme is clear: consumers want value that compounds, not value that disappears. They seek brands that treat rewards as part of a long-term financial relationship, not a promotional tactic. Retailers that embrace value-first ecosystems will capture deeper loyalty and greater lifetime engagement.

item.title: MBSB expects smartphone industry to experience a challenging 2026
item.description: MBSB Research said Thursday that it has maintained its neutral stance on Malaysia's technology sector as it viewed that the smartphone industry is anticipated to experience a challenging 2026.

item.title: NeutraDC partners Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 to expand data centers in Indonesia, Singapore
item.description: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with NeutraDC to connect Hokkaido Ishikari, Indonesia and Singapore, the network hub of Asia, and provide digital infrastructure that enables service deployment across all three markets for users of Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1.

item.title: Paydibs, AltPayNet team up to provide payment services between Malaysia and the Philippines
item.description: Paydibs Sdn Bhd, a Malaysia-based payment firm, has announced a strategic partnership with AltPayNet, a payment service provider based in the Philippines, to provide payment services between Malaysia and the Philippines.

item.title: Why Asia Pacific’s over 45 founders are the new face of Unicorn ambition
item.description: The 'Unicorn' dream is alive and well in Asia-Pacific, but it is being driven by experience rather than youth.

item.title: Singapore’s GIC partners Sony Music to buy music catalogs
item.description: GIC, a Singapore-based institutional investor, and Sony Music Group (SMG), a Japan-based music group, announced Wednesday the establishment of an investment partnership to acquire and amplify high‑quality, marquee music catalog assets across a range of genres.
